nodes.summary: A conditional finite-volume form of the Aizenman–Barsky–Fernández inequality: if the GHS bound holds at `o` and the GHS bounds sum to `J ⟨σ_o⟩ χ(o)`, then the bond-energy susceptibility is at most `J ⟨σ_o⟩ χ(o)`.
nodes.title: Conditional finite-volume Aizenman–Barsky–Fernández inequality

nodes.summary: The bond-energy susceptibility `∑_{e ∈ E} Cov(σ_o, σ_e)`.
nodes.title: Bond-energy susceptibility

nodes.summary: The covariance `⟨σ_o σ_x σ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x σ_y⟩` of `σ_o` with the bond variable of `e = {x, y}`.
nodes.title: Covariance of a spin with a bond variable

nodes.summary: The GHS bound `Cov(σ_o, σ_x)⟨σ_y⟩ + Cov(σ_o, σ_y)⟨σ_x⟩` for the bond `e = {x, y}`.
nodes.title: GHS bound for a bond

nodes.summary: The GHS inequality at `o` for every edge: `cov3sym ≤ ghsBoundSym`, equivalently `u₃(o, x, y) ≤ 0` for every edge `{x, y}`.
nodes.title: GHS three-point inequality at a site for every edge

nodes.summary: The negative Hamiltonian `∑_{xy ∈ E} σ_xσ_y + h ∑_x σ_x`.
nodes.title: Negative Hamiltonian of the Ising model
